mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) that increase QT prolongation risk, and fluphenazine is a typical antipsychotic with inherent QT-prolonging properties.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes regularly; consider alternative antivirals if possible; ensure electrolyte repletion during foscarnet therapy; avoid other QT-prolonging agents.
